</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: 2em;"><b>35th Stratagem</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><b>连环计</b></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">(lián huán jì)</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Chain Stratagems</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
In matters of dear import, one must often use several stratagems
applied simultaneously, one after another, as a chain. However, one
must also remember that with several interdependent plans operating
together, it only takes one of them failing to break the chain,
potentially resulting in overall failure.</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, serif;"><i><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-weight: normal;">Chain
Stratagems</span></span></i></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
is associated with the seventh hexagram, </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><i><span style="text-decoration: none;">Earth
over Water</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">.
The yang line in the second position is the general, or commander,
and links together the surrounding yin lines, which are his
subordinates The general is wholly responsible for these subordinates
and can, without interference, link together and implement
multifaceted plans </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">[1],
[28]</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">.</span></span></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section46" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">to destroy: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">毁坏</span></span>:
	huǐhuài   
	</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	to pretend: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">假装</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">假扮</span></span>:
	jiǎzhuāng/jiǎbàn   
	</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	to act: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">扮演</span></span>:
	bànyǎn</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	actor: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">演员</span></span>:
	yǎnyuán</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	to become (e.g. to become a doctor): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">当</span></span>:
	dāng</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><a name="tw-source-rmn150"></a></span><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">chain (e.g. a metal chain): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">链条:
	liàntiáo</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">chain (e.g. a chain of restaurants): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">连锁:
	liánsuǒ</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	to skate: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">滑冰</span></span>:
	huábīng</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	to ice skate: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">溜冰</span></span>:
	liūbīng</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	not allowed: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">不许</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">不允许</span></span>:
	bùxǔ/bù yǔnxǔ   
	</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	to escape (e.g. from a situation): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">避开</span></span>:
	bì kāi   
	</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	to escape (e.g. from reality): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">逃避</span></span>:
	táobì</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	situation/happening: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">情况</span></span>:
	qíngkuàng   
	</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><a name="tw-target-text1"></a></span></span>
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">fog: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">雾</span></span></span>:
	wù   </span></span>
	</p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	to convince/persuade: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">说服</span></span>:
	shuōfú</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	contest/competition: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">竞赛</span></span>:
	jìngsài   
	</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	game/match: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">比赛</span></span>:
	bǐsài   
	</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	effort: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">努力</span></span>:
	nǔlì   
	</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	cause: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">引起</span></span>:
	yǐnqǐ</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	result: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">结果</span></span>:
	jiéguǒ</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><a name="tw-source-rmn152"></a></span><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">serial/interlinked:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">连环:
	liánhuán</span><span style="color: #333333;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
	  </span></span></span>
	</p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	to cause: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">导致</span></span>:
	dǎozhì</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	limit: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">限制</span></span>:
	xiànzhì   
	</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	reality: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">现实</span></span>:
	xiànshí   
	</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	team: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">团队</span></span>:
	tuánduì   
	</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	disappointed: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">失望</span></span>:
	shīwàng</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	respect: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">尊敬</span></span>:
	zūnjìng</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><a name="tw-source-rmn48"></a></span></span>
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">to
	disrupt: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">打乱</span></span></span>:
	dǎ luàn</span></span></p>
</div><br>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
to become (e.g. to become angry): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">变</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">变成</span></span>:
biàn/biàn chéng</span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="font-size: x-large;"><b><span style="color: #333333;">Sample Sentences 35:</span></b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br />

</p>
<div dir="ltr" id="Section87" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
    1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">桥被毁坏了，我们走不过去。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: The bridge has been
	destroyed, we cannot walk across it.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这些结果不够写一篇论文。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: These results are not
	enough to write a paper.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">非常感谢你帮我！</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">不应该为了逃避现实而喝酒。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">因为有雾，他们从监狱逃走的安排被打乱</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我不觉得他们的团队能赢得溜冰竞赛。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那么不好的情况，你应该努力避开。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我欣赏这一种音乐。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    9) </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"> </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">我自行车的链条掉下来了。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span style="background: rgb(255, 255, 255);">
    10) </span></span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">这是一家连锁超市。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">说服他不太困难。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他们的团队输了比赛</span></span>.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	13) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她毕业以后要当医生。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	14) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你为什么失望？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我刚发现不允许爬黄山，因为被封</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;起来了。</span></span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    15) </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">警察抓住了那个连环杀手。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	16) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他假扮什么人，就像什么人。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	17) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我不太喜欢那部电影的演员。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	18) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他大声喊，想引起我们的注意。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	19) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">有很多她不能察觉到的原因导致了失</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;败。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	20) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她非常尊敬艺术家。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	21) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我的女儿喜欢扮演医生。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    22) </span></span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">他发现不许爬山的时候，变得很难过。</span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333;">-------------------------------------</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/04/notes-from-china-chapter-34-inflict.html">Previous Chapter</a><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/04/notes-from-china-chapter-36-if-all-else.html">Next Chapter</a>&nbsp;<br /></span></p>
